data_fields.name: bonus_roll_first_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: 40 percent while no hub exists on a shallow tier, else 15

best_idea: Keep a server-side count of placed hub services and owe one more whenever the count falls below a depth-based line, so a missed hub is owed again on the next zone instead of being lost, and place each service one at a time with a personal-space clear so services never crowd each other.
decision_why: Keep the owed-count budget with its debt carry and the one-at-a-time placement with personal space; move the cadence numbers into zone data per tier; do not rely on random extra rolls as the only source of hubs; fix the item-reroll failsafe.
acceptance: A seeded server test with extra rolls off asserts hubs are owed on tiers 3, 7 and 11 in the first 12 tiers; a test that forces one attempt to fail asserts the hub is owed again on the next tier; a placed hub never has two services closer than the personal-space rule allows.
